v1.18.6 (18 April 2024) |feed_title = Update v1.18.4 |previous_update = [[v1.18.0|Mission Quests Update]] |next_update = [[V1.19.0|Mercenary Base Update]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''v1.18.4''' is the seventy-second update to be released in Tower Defense Simulator, on the 12th of April 2024. It added the {{Color|Deluxe|Cameraman}} [[Gladiator]] skin and made improvements to multiple existing skins. This update encompassed five versions, the main v1.18.4 update (released 12 April 2024) and four minor updates, v1.18.4a (released 13 April 2024), v1.18.4b (released 13 April 2024), v1.18.4c (released 13 April 2024) and v1.18.6 (released 18 April 2024). ==Additions== *New skin for the [[Deluxe Crate]] **{{Color|Deluxe|Cameraman}} [[Gladiator]] ==Changes & Bugfixes== *New Level 0-4 animations for the {{Color|Premium|Redemption}} [[Sniper]]. *{{Color|Premium|DRKSHDW}} [[Crook Boss]] skin's [[Pistol Goon|Goon1]], [[Tommy Goon 1|Goon2]] and [[Tommy Goon 2|Goon3]] appearance changed. *{{Color|Deluxe|Soviet}} [[Crook Boss]] skin's [[Tommy Goon 1|Goon2]] and [[Tommy Goon 2|Goon3]] appearance changed. *Removed the {{Color|Premium|Toilet}} [[Scout]], {{Color|Premium|Toilet}} [[Soldier]] and {{Color|Premium|Chad}} [[Minigunner]] from the [[Premium Crate]]. *Updated lobby. **Now has a countdown timer for a new tower to release. **[[Elevators#Special Elevators|Special Elevators]] removed. *Added version number in the bottom right corner of the screen. *Fixed the {{Color|Halloween|Pumpkin}} [[Demoman]] skin having no weapon and firing animations at Level 3-4. :In '''v1.18.4a''': *Fixed {{Color|Premium|Redemption}} [[Sniper]] animations. :In '''v1.18.4b''': *Countdown timer now ends at 19th of April 2024, 21:00 UTC instead of 19th of April 2024, 20:00 UTC. *Fixed the timer being set to 13th of April 2024, 20:00 UTC. :In '''v1.18.4c''': *Countdown timer now ends at 19th of April 2024, 20:00 UTC instead of 19th of April 2024, 21:00 UTC. *Fixed the timer being set to 13th of April 2024, 21:00 UTC. :In '''v1.18.6''': *In-game version number changed from ''v1.18.4'' to ''v1.18.6''. ==Gallery== {{Gallery|Open = Yes| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} V.1.17.0 UPD THMBNL.png {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} V1.15Icon2.png GRIcon.png }} ==Official Update Log== ''NOTE: Not everything here will be accurate, as this is transcribed from the in-game update log. Several things may be incorrect, and there may be things that are missing.'' ====v1.18.4==== {{UpdateLog| {{UpdateBanner|MilitaryBasePI.png|Update v1.18.4}} {{UpdateH1|📜Update Log:}} {{UpdateH3|⏱️Countdown}} *☒ New tower releasing next week! {{UpdateH3|🚽 New Deluxe Skin!}} *📷 Cameraman [[Gladiator]] {{UpdateThumbnail|V1.18.4-Image1.png|Can be found in the [[Deluxe Crate|Deluxe Crate]]!}} {{UpdateH3|🔧 Fixed Skins!}} *🧛 Added Goons for DRKSHDW [[Crook Boss]] *🪆 Updated weapons for Soviet [[Crook Boss]] *🐎 Added custom animations for Redemption [[Sniper]] *🎃 Fixed Pumpkin [[Demoman]] *🔥 Removed [[Lord Exo]] skin again }} {{UpdateNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:v1.18.4}} [[Category:Modern Updates]]
